passages.title: HR policy: relocation support
passages.heading: Additions
passages.meta: version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-06-01 · supersedes: HB-29
passages.text: For employees relocating with dependent children, 500 EUR is added to the standard relocation lump sum. Managers confirm claims for the relocation lump sum before payment in the next payroll run. The HR publishes worked examples of the relocation lump sum on the intranet.

passages.title: Memo: relocation lump sum exceptions
passages.heading: Purpose
passages.text: This memo lists group exceptions to the relocation lump sum in HB-34. Managers confirm claims for the relocation lump sum before payment in the next payroll run. The HR publishes worked examples of the relocation lump sum on the intranet.

passages.title: HR policy: relocation support
passages.heading: Standard relocation lump sum
passages.meta: version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-05-01 to the day before 2026-06-01 · superseded by: HB-34
passages.text: Employees who relocate at the company's request receive a relocation lump sum of 2500 EUR. Managers confirm claims for the relocation lump sum before payment in the next payroll run. The HR reviews the relocation lump sum once a year and announces changes in advance.

passages.title: HR policy: relocation support
passages.heading: Standard relocation lump sum
passages.meta: version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-06-01 · supersedes: HB-29
passages.text: Employees who relocate at the company's request receive a relocation lump sum of 3000 EUR. Questions about the relocation lump sum go to the HR, who keeps the record of decisions. Each claim for the relocation lump sum needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier.

passages.title: HR policy: relocation support
passages.heading: Scope
passages.meta: version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-06-01 · supersedes: HB-29
passages.text: This policy sets the relocation lump sum for all employees. The HR publishes worked examples of the relocation lump sum on the intranet. Claims for the relocation lump sum are filed in the expense tool under 'HR policy: relocation support'.
